findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: match_lens_to_sensor, read_shopify_products, get_checkout · Private data: get_shopify_readonly_config_status, read_shopify_products, get_cart · Public sink: update_cart, create_checkout, get_checkout, submit_rfq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: match_lens_to_sensor, read_shopify_products, get_checkout · Private data: get_shopify_readonly_config_status, read_shopify_products, get_cart · Public sink: update_cart, create_checkout, get_checkout, submit_rfq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
